BRAKE SYSTEM – ANTI–LOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS)

Tc Terminal Circuit

CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION

Connecting terminals Tc and E1 of the DLC1 or the DLC2 causes the ECU to display the diagnostic
trouble code by flashing the ABS warning light.
